checks.name: Public health does not create sessions; CSP, anti-framing, no-referrer and nosniff headers present
Environment, Git metadata, database, key file and server source paths are not served
New visitor cookie is Secure, HttpOnly and SameSite=Strict; no wallet identity inherited
Missing CSRF header, forged origin, oversized body and unsupported method rejected
Anonymous wallet purchase and ZIP download rejected; no other buyer licenses visible
Public catalog and inspection report omit creator Python source and prompt
Public POST rate limit enforced and requester-supplied backend identity cannot bypass it

scope: Targeted checks on the owner-authorized prototype. Not an independent penetration test or a guarantee against unknown vulnerabilities.
